evidence.quote: Courses are held entirely in English.
At Rhein-Waal University of Applied Sciences, you do not pay tuition fees, as it is a state university in North Rhine-Westphalia.

Applying with a school-leaving qualification obtained outside of Germany First, register on hochschulstart.de. There, you will be given an applicant ID (BID) and an applicant authentication number (BAN). You can then use these details to apply via uni-assist.

value.quotedAs: Proof of sufficient English language proficiency for English-taught degree programmes

evidence.quote: Proof of sufficient English language proficiency for English-taught degree programmes

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page says "Tuition fees per semester None" and the HSRW living-costs page states no tuition fees at the state university; a semester contribution of approx. 300 EUR exists ("Enrolment fees amount to approximately 300 EUR per semester.") but is not tuition. Intake: only the start of studies date (1 September) is given; the application deadline (15 July) is stated without a year, so it was left out of the intakes fact. Evidence for the deadline without year: "For the winter semester: until 15 July". ApplicationChannel: chosen de-uni-assist because the programme page states foreign-qualification applicants apply via uni-assist; no VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) is mentioned. Documents: only the enrolment document "Proof of sufficient English language proficiency for English-taught degree programmes" is explicitly named for this context.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.:
TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4 Reading: 4 Listening: 4 Speaking: 4 Writing: 4

Some Bachelor’s degree programmes are allocated via the Dialogue-Oriented Service Procedure (DoSV) run by the Foundation for University Admissions.
